name: Aloha Solar Panel Cleaning LLC
old_description: We're sorry but vue doesn't work properly without JavaScript enabled. Please enable it to continue.
about:
Aloha Solar Panel Cleaning LLC operates from Haleiwa on the island of O‘ahu, Hawaii. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founder is named in available sources.

The firm provides solar panel cleaning for residential, commercial, and utility-scale installations using both manual methods and robotic equipment. It also offers bird proofing with mesh, spikes, and visual deterrents, as well as vegetation management for solar farms. The company states it cleans thousands of photovoltaic modules across the Hawaiian Islands, serving clients on O‘ahu, Kaua‘i, Moloka‘i, Maui, Lana‘i, and the Big Island.

Customers include homeowners, commercial property owners, utility companies, operations-and-maintenance firms, homeowners associations, and property management companies. The service area covers all major Hawaiian islands, with residential work scheduled on an annual basis and commercial, industrial, and utility projects available throughout the chain.

Aloha Solar Panel Cleaning emphasizes safety and compliance: its field staff are OSHA certified, the company holds NFPA 70E certification, and it is licensed and in good standing with the State of Hawaii. The use of robotic cleaning technology is cited as a way to handle installations of any size efficiently and safely.

name: Aloha T-Shirt Factory
old_description: To play, press and hold the enter key. To stop, release the enter key.
about:
Aloha T-Shirt Factory operates in Honolulu, Hawaii, providing custom screen printing and garment decoration services. The company offers a range of printing methods including traditional screen printing, direct-to-garment (DTG), direct-to-film (DTF), and embroidery, all produced locally in its Honolulu facility.

The shop handles orders as small as 24 pieces and provides design assistance and art vectoring to prepare artwork for production. In addition to T-shirts, the company prints on trucker hats, tote bags, and a variety of apparel blanks such as 100% cotton, Dri-fit polyester, poly-cotton blends, and tri-blend fabrics. Customers may also supply their own garments for printing. Contract printing and delivery services are available for businesses needing wholesale production.

Its customer base spans retail shops, construction companies, churches, school uniform programs, non-profit organizations, military units, and family reunions. The company emphasizes that small and large orders receive equal attention, and it positions itself as a local resource for custom apparel across the Hawaiian islands.

Aloha T-Shirt Factory states its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction with the motto: "If you are happy tell your friends, if not tell us." The business highlights that all printing is done in Honolulu, distinguishing it from offshore or mainland competitors.

name: Alpha Circuit
old_description: Where signal integrity, thermal control, and reliability converge
about:
Alpha Circuit is headquartered in Elmhurst, Illinois. The company is certified as a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and holds ITAR registration for defense-related work.

The company manufactures high-performance printed circuit boards with a focus on signal integrity, thermal management, and reliability. Its vertically integrated operation controls materials, processes, and inspection at every stage to deliver repeatable outcomes for RF and microwave systems, high-speed digital architectures, and multilayer designs engineered for heat dissipation. The firm describes its approach as "process is the product," emphasizing that discipline, not equipment lists, defines capability.

Alpha Circuit serves space-based, defense, and medical programs that require absolute stability. Customers include organizations building systems where failure is not an option, such as satellite payloads, radar modules, and implantable medical devices.

The company was started to close the gap between advanced design and real-world manufacturing. It emphasizes early partnership, systemic thinking, and relentless execution to deliver solutions that perform in demanding environments. Full traceability from incoming material to final test is maintained as a standard practice.

about:
Alpha Custom Apparel operates from West Bend, Wisconsin. The company was founded by Christina Ongert, who serves as president and owner, drawing on 27 years of fashion and manufacturing experience. Ongert established the business to assist independent fashion brands, organizations, companies, and e‑commerce retailers with sourcing, textile production, and broader manufacturing needs.

The firm manages the full supply chain — design and development, fabric and trim sourcing, sample creation, bulk production, packaging, quality‑control checks, and delivery logistics. It leverages a global network of manufacturing partners while emphasizing localized decoration and production to reduce costs, emissions, and lead times. Product categories span athletic and team apparel, promotional and hardline items, retail and corporate apparel, construction‑grade hi‑vis gear, and managed company stores.

Clients range from independent fashion labels and online retailers to schools, nonprofits, and corporate brands. Notable partnerships include Good Karma Brands and the ESPN Tailgate at the Tundra Trio in Green Bay, where Alpha supplies branded giveaways such as hats, blankets, and fans. The company also supports local organizations like West Bend High Schools, the Wisconsin 911 Memorial, and various community nonprofits.

Alpha differentiates itself through an innovative design approach and a stated goal of cutting concept‑to‑completion time in half. The leadership team positions the company as a creative partner that brings fashion‑forward thinking to industries that traditionally treat apparel as purely functional, aiming to empower anyone with a creative idea to launch or grow a brand.

name: Alpha Electric Supply
old_description: Click here to find out about our promotions and upcoming events.
about:
Alpha Electric Supply was founded in 1987 on the island of Maui by four electrical-supply veterans with a combined 105 years of experience. The company is headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii, and is owned by Honsador Holdings LLC and Doman Building Materials Group Ltd. Honsador, a Hawaiian business dating back to 1935, operates 15 branch locations across the islands and employs over 250 people across its family of companies.

Alpha operates as a wholesale distributor of electrical products, sourcing from a broad network of manufacturers rather than producing its own goods. Its branches on Maui, Oahu, Kauai, and the Big Island (Hilo and Kona) stock wire, conduit, lighting, circuit breakers, switchgear, photovoltaic equipment, and related materials. The company provides delivery using a fleet of vans, pickup trucks, stakebed/flatbed trucks, and heavy-duty utility trucks, and offers project pricing, credit accounts with Net 30 terms, and takeoff/quotation services from customer plans.

The supplier serves commercial, industrial, residential, utility, and photovoltaic market segments throughout Hawaii. Its customer base includes contractors, businesses, and homeowners seeking energy-efficient products, resilient power systems, and safety technologies. Alpha also supports commercial energy projects and home energy solutions through dedicated programs.

The company’s stated differentiator is a service philosophy captured in its motto: the customer is the purpose of the business, not an interruption. Alpha emphasizes that it does not private-label products, maintains market-specific inventory from qualified manufacturers, and leverages long-standing vendor relationships to secure competitive pricing and availability.

name: Alpha Plastics, Inc
old_description: Alpha Plastics is Proud to Be ISO 9001: 2015 Certified by PRI Registrar
about:
Alpha Plastics, Inc. operates from Coon Rapids, Minnesota, where it was founded in 1976. The company is family- and veteran-owned, drawing on over 100 years of combined experience among its team.

The shop specializes in plastic pressure forming and thermoforming, producing parts such as polycarbonate defrosting ducts, polyethylene shrouds and dump wagon tubs, polycarbonate access doors, and Kydex shrouds. It runs prototype, short-run, and long-run production, and offers value-added services including assembly, finishing, custom packaging, logistics support, and EMI coatings.

Alpha Plastics serves customers across the United States and ships to Mexico. Its client base includes brands such as Schwans (food processing), 3M (industrial), BAE Systems (defense), Life Touch (photography), Ariens (outdoor power equipment), and Jacobsen (turf equipment), indicating a reach into food, industrial, defense, imaging, and outdoor equipment sectors.

The company emphasizes its ability to handle difficult parts, lower custom part costs, rapid prototyping, and free estimates.

name: Altitude Steel Structures
old_description: Design your steel building online in minutes with our free 3D Builder. Customize every detail, compare options, and request a personalized quote—all before making your purchase.
about:
Altitude Steel Structures operates from South Salt Lake City, Utah. The company has been in business for 2.5 years, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly stated. The business began with a focus on providing custom steel buildings through an online 3D design tool that allows customers to configure structures before purchase.

The company designs, engineers, fabricates, and installs custom steel buildings including carports, storage buildings, workshops, and agricultural structures. All services—structural engineering, foundation work, fabrication, delivery, and installation—are performed in-house. To date, Altitude has completed over 200 buildings across Utah, Idaho, and Colorado. The structures use coated galvanized steel and Sherwin Williams paint finishes.

Customers range from general contractors and small business owners to residential homeowners. A general contractor chose Altitude for a storage facility after comparing wood and steel options. A sprinkler business owner needed a 30-by-50-foot shop for equipment storage. Other projects include custom detached garages with windows and vents, a metal building praised by a building inspector, and a garage converted from architect drawings. Installations are typically completed in one to two days.

Altitude differentiates itself with a fully integrated in-house process, 100 percent U.S.-sourced steel components, and warranties covering workmanship for one year, steel components for 20 years, and paint for 20 years. Contractors are fully licensed and meet local and international safety standards. A free online 3D builder lets clients customize every detail and request quotes instantly.

name: Altium Packaging
old_description: Ask us about our variety of caps, closures, and liner solutions today!
about:
Altium Packaging operates from Janesville, Wisconsin, with a corporate office in Atlanta, Georgia. The company traces its roots back over a century of innovation in plastic packaging, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly stated.

The company manufactures rigid plastic containers, bottles, caps, closures, and liner solutions for a wide range of markets. Its proprietary Dura-Lite® lightweighting technology reduces resin use by 5 to 32 percent while maintaining top-load strength and drop performance. Altium runs a network of more than 65 plants across the United States and Canada, staffed by nearly 4,000 employees, and operates an in-house design studio, Studio PKG™, that develops custom packaging with PCR resin options.

Altium serves the dairy, water, beverage, food, nutrition, household chemicals, specialty chemicals, automotive, personal care, and healthcare sectors. In healthcare, its Altium Healthcare line supplies containers and closures for prescription, over-the-counter, and wellness products with child- and senior-resistant features. Customers include brand owners seeking stock or custom rigid plastic packaging.

The company emphasizes a customer-centric model built on personalized service, dependability, flexibility, and creativity. It highlights sustainability practices, long-term partnerships, and its "Always Made Right®" commitment as core differentiators.
